content_text: I’m a young filmmaker who would love to hear from a dialect coach on the podcast. It’s one part of the industry I really know nothing about, and I think it would make for a great episode, especially for aspiring directors, since coaches work across so many projects. I see William Conacher and Liz Himelstein credited a lot in my research on the topic, for example. Thank you!
